guide.title: Welcome to Akira!
guide.intro: Akira is a modern application for 3D animation, motion capture, and working with MMD models. This guide will help you quickly get started and use all the features.
guide.step1: Main page: Here you will find the latest news, social links, support, and can proceed to create or select scenes.
guide.step2: Scenes and models: In the 'Scenes' section, you can create new scenes, upload your 3D models (.bpmx format), and select animations for them.
guide.step3: Loading animations: Go to a scene, use the control panel to load .vmd animation files. You can combine several animations and control their parameters.
guide.step4: Motion Capture: Use the built-in motion capture with your camera. Open the corresponding panel, select a video source, and start capturing. Movements will be automatically applied to the selected model.
guide.step5: Materials and appearance: In the 'Materials' panel, you can adjust colors, transparency, and other material parameters.
guide.step6: Export: After creating an animation, you can export the result to GLTF or VMD formats for further use.
guide.step7: Voice assistant and AI: The built-in AI assistant helps generate animations, gives tips, and automates routine tasks.
guide.step8: Support and feedback: If you have questions or suggestions, join our Discord or write on GitHub.
